As a result of all this, too many people that don’t fit tech’s narrow norm still feel like their identity or
background is a barrier to success in the European ecosystem.
It’s also important not to discuss people’s backgrounds as if they were mutually exclusive. Human
heterogeneity is intersectional; a lot of people represent more than one underrepresented group.
Data on selected intersectional demographics from State of European Tech 2019 shows that in those
cases, barriers compound.
